Millwood Chemistry Class.name: Millwood Chemistry Class
Millwood Chemistry Class.description: A standard high school chemistry lab with black-topped tables, Bunsen burners, and the faint smell of sulfur and floor wax. Periodic tables line the walls. This is where Jake and Violet first connected over their shared secrets as supers in hiding.

hallway door.description: A standard classroom door leading to the main hallway.
hallway door.pass_message: You step out into the busy hallway.
hallway door.visible_in_direction: The bustling main hallway of Millwood Public Schools.

Millwood Hallway.name: Millwood Hallway
Millwood Hallway.description: The main corridor of Millwood Public Schools, a small PK-12 school. Lockers line both walls, and the linoleum floor scuffs under hundreds of shoes. The fluorescent lights buzz overhead. Students cluster in groups between classes.

chemistry door.description: The door back to the chemistry classroom.
chemistry door.visible_in_direction: The chemistry lab with its black-topped tables.

history door.description: The door to the history classroom.
history door.visible_in_direction: Rows of desks facing a whiteboard covered in dates.

front exit.description: The school's front entrance leading outside to the wooded path.
front exit.pass_message: You push through the double doors into the Oklahoma afternoon.
front exit.visible_in_direction: Sunlight and the tree line of the woods beyond the parking lot.

properties.description: The main corridor of Millwood Public Schools. Lockers line both walls, and fluorescent lights buzz overhead.

Millwood History Class.name: Millwood History Class
Millwood History Class.description: A history classroom where Violet once spoke up about supers during a lesson. Desks face a whiteboard covered in timelines. A world map hangs crookedly on one wall.

hallway door.description: The door back to the main hallway.

properties.description: A history classroom where Violet once spoke up about supers during a lesson.

The Old Steel Mill.name: The Old Steel Mill
The Old Steel Mill.description: An abandoned industrial site about twenty minutes from Millwood, rusting in the Oklahoma weather. Corrugated metal walls are pocked with holes. A deep, metal-lined shaft dominates the center of the main floor — Jake uses it to practice his electromagnetic powers. The railgun hole in the far wall attracted government agents and the Amalgam. The air is thick with dust and the echo of dripping water.

environment.noise: echoing drips and wind through holes

woods path.description: A rusted side door leading back into the forest.
woods path.pass_message: You squeeze through the gap in the rusted door.
woods path.visible_in_direction: The dense tree line of the woods.

shaft ladder.description: A bolted steel ladder descending into the deep metal-lined testing shaft.
shaft ladder.pass_message: You climb down the cold rungs into the shaft.
shaft ladder.visible_in_direction: A dark, cylindrical shaft dropping about forty feet. The walls are lined with dented metal plating.

properties.description: An abandoned industrial site with a deep metal-lined shaft. Jake uses it to test his powers. The railgun hole in the wall drew unwanted attention.

Steel Mill Shaft.name: Steel Mill Shaft
Steel Mill Shaft.description: A deep, cylindrical shaft lined with dented metal plating, descending about forty feet below the mill floor. Scorch marks and small craters pock the walls from Jake's railgun tests. The air is cooler here and smells of iron. Faint electromagnetic hums linger in the metal.

shaft ladder up.description: The steel ladder leading back up to the main mill floor.
shaft ladder up.pass_message: You climb back up into the mill.
shaft ladder up.visible_in_direction: The dim main floor of the steel mill above.

properties.description: A deep metal-lined shaft used by Jake for power testing. Scorch marks and craters cover the walls.

Halloway House Kitchen.name: Halloway House Kitchen
Halloway House Kitchen.description: A messy, lived-in suburban kitchen that hides in plain sight through its sheer lack of curation. Pots are stacked haphazardly, dishes crowd the sink, and the counter bears fresh scuff marks. The Halloways use chaos as camouflage — no government agent would believe a super family lives in this mess.

bathroom door.description: A narrow door leading to the downstairs bathroom.
bathroom door.pass_message: You slip into the small bathroom.
bathroom door.visible_in_direction: A cramped bathroom with a single sink and mirror.

living room arch.description: An open archway leading to the living room.
living room arch.visible_in_direction: A cluttered living room with mismatched furniture.

back door.description: The back door leading to the wooded path behind the house.
back door.pass_message: You step out into the woods behind the Halloway house.
back door.visible_in_direction: The dense tree line of the woods.

properties.description: A messy kitchen that serves as camouflage for the Halloway family's secret super identities.

Halloway House Bathroom.name: Halloway House Bathroom
Halloway House Bathroom.description: A cramped downstairs bathroom with a single sink, a toilet, and a medicine cabinet. The mirror is slightly fogged. This is where Jake carefully treated Violet's injured foot after she stepped on glass at the steel mill.

kitchen door.description: The door back to the kitchen.

properties.description: A small bathroom where Jake treated Violet's foot injury.

Halloway House Living Room.name: Halloway House Living Room
Halloway House Living Room.description: A cluttered living room with mismatched furniture, stacked board games, and a TV playing something nobody is watching. The chaos is deliberate — camouflage for a family of supers hiding from the government. A worn leather jacket hangs over the back of the couch.

kitchen arch.description: The archway back to the kitchen.

properties.description: A deliberately chaotic living room that camouflages the Halloway family.

Parr House Living Room.name: Parr House Living Room
Parr House Living Room.description: An immaculately kept suburban living room that serves as the Parr family's perfect disguise. Everything is in its place — until now. The front wall has been blown outward, exposing the interior to the night air and the harsh glare of government floodlights. Debris litters the carpet. The site of the joint family meeting and the Amalgam's devastating attack.

destroyed front.description: The shattered remains of the front wall, now a gaping hole opening to the yard.
destroyed front.pass_message: You step over broken drywall and twisted rebar into the yard.
destroyed front.visible_in_direction: The destroyed front yard, lit by government floodlights.

properties.description: The Parr family living room, now destroyed by the Amalgam's attack. The front wall is gone.

Parr House Front Yard.name: Parr House Front Yard
Parr House Front Yard.description: The once-perfect Parr family front yard is now a disaster zone. The front of the house is blown out, framing the interior like a stage set. Government floodlights cast harsh white light. Tire tracks from unmarked black SUVs scar the lawn. Agents in dark suits are converging. The night air is thick with tension.

living room.description: The gaping hole where the front wall used to be.
living room.pass_message: You step back inside through the destroyed wall.

woods trail.description: A narrow trail at the edge of the yard leading into the woods.
woods trail.pass_message: You slip into the tree line.
woods trail.visible_in_direction: The dark tree line of the woods.

properties.description: The destroyed Parr front yard, now swarming with government agents and floodlights.

The Woods.name: The Woods
The Woods.description: A dense, forested path connecting the school, the steel mill, and the neighborhoods. The canopy is thick enough to block most moonlight. The shadows here seem to move on their own, and the ambient sounds of insects occasionally fall dead silent — a sign the Amalgam is near. This was the site of the creature's initial ambush on Jake and Violet.

environment.smell: pine, damp earth, and faint decay

school entrance.description: The path back to Millwood Public Schools.
school entrance.pass_message: You emerge at the school entrance.
school entrance.visible_in_direction: The school building in the distance.

mill entrance.visible_in_direction: The rusting silhouette of the steel mill.

parr yard trail.visible_in_direction: Floodlights glow through the trees ahead.

Prescription glasses for double vision, rarely worn. Smudged and slightly bent from being sat on. The frames are utilitarian and a little too big for Jake's face.
A simple dark hairband used to keep Violet's long black hair out of her face. She fidgets with it when nervous.
A worn, vintage leather jacket adorned with subtle silver rings and punk studs. Smells faintly of clove cigarettes and ozone. It looks like armor.

A severed piece of the Amalgam — a twitching mass of black tendrils and dark biomass. It smells of copper and ancient earth. It slowly attempts to re-knit itself. Touching it directly is extremely dangerous.

A sleek, silver government device used to wipe the short-term memories of civilians who witness superhero activity. It has a small screen and a single activation button. A government serial number is etched on the back.
A phone case melted and warped by stray electromagnetic sparks and forcefield friction. Vi is demanding recompense for this. It smells of burnt plastic.
A standard white first aid kit stocked with bandages, antiseptic wipes, tweezers, and gauze. Used by Jake to treat Violet's foot after she stepped on glass at the steel mill.
A faded black bandana that Marcus always wore. It smells of motor oil and leather. It feels heavier than it should.

properties.personality: You are Jake Halloway, 18. Chaotic, unfiltered, oscillating between shy and hyperactively silly. Fiercely intelligent but socially oblivious, you use sexual humor and bad puns to deflect and connect. Deeply loyal, you always ask permission and respect boundaries despite your impulsive nature. Known as the 'weird kid' at school but unbothered by it. Your electromagnetic powers require precision — emotional states cause uncontrolled bursts.
properties.description: An 18-year-old with seagreen eyes flecked with gold, short stiff hair that sticks up, and a slim build. He wears a utilitarian hoodie and jeans. Sparks of static electricity occasionally crackle at his fingertips.
properties.base_description: Jake Halloway, 18, 175cm, 71kg, slim build. Seagreen eyes with golden/amber flecks, short stiff hair. Style is utilitarian, lived-in — mostly hoodies and jeans. Son of Leah and Marcus Halloway, brother to Erin and Vi. His electromagnetic powers let him fire railgun-like projectiles, levitate metal, manipulate electronics, numb nerves, deliver shocks, and perform Tesla coil discharges.

emotion.description: Still buzzing from the Amalgam encounter.

properties.personality: You are Violet Parr, 18. Flirty and fun on the surface, but deeply conflicted. You present as a 'good girl' at school and home, but harbor secret desires and shame you share with no one. Intelligent, insightful, and fiercely protective of those you care about, you have spent years hiding your true self out of fear. You are lonely and desperate for someone who accepts all of you. Your invisibility is triggered involuntarily by anxiety.
properties.description: An 18-year-old with long black hair, blue-violet eyes, and a waifish face. She wears a hairband and a simple outfit. When anxious, her edges shimmer and fade as she begins to turn invisible.
properties.base_description: Violet Parr, 18, 5'4", 100 lbs, skinny build, long black hair, blue-violet eyes. Daughter of Bob (Mr. Incredible) and Helen (Elastigirl). Powers: invisibility (anxiety-triggered) and violet-hued forcefields. At age 10, helped defeat Syndrome. A government mind-wipe incident forced the family to relocate to Oklahoma.

emotion.description: Shaken by the Amalgam attack and exposed secrets.

properties.personality: Sarcastic, mischievous, and a self-proclaimed 'menace.' Sharp-tongued but affectionate. Often jealous that Jake does 'cool' things with others but not her.
properties.description: A 15-year-old with a sharp grin and restless energy. Jake's younger sister.
properties.base_description: Violet 'Vi' Halloway, 15. Powers: intangibility (phase through solid matter) and voice-cloning (perfectly mimic any voice and throw it). Once used her dad's voice to try to get a credit card number.

emotion.description: Still mad about her ruined phone case.

properties.personality: Cool, intimidating, and seemingly aloof, but fiercely protective of her family. Selective about who she interacts with. Uses her power subtly. Smokes.
properties.description: An older sister (graduated last year) with dark hair, punk/goth style, ripped jeans, and band tees. A cigarette dangles from her fingers.
properties.base_description: Erin Halloway, graduated last year. Powers: emotional manipulation through her voice — her singing can influence feelings (calm, joy, fear). Not mind control, but powerful suggestion. Once calmed a furious Bob Parr with a lullaby in exchange for $200.

properties.personality: Stern, intimidating, fair, and utterly unflappable. A retired government spy known as 'Swift.' Analytical and strategic but deeply caring. She twists Jake's ear when he's reckless. Looks like she could beat the shit out of you but also be kind about it.
properties.description: Angular, dark hair with a silver streak, goth/punk style — leather jacket, band tees, silver rings. Her eyes miss nothing.
properties.base_description: Leah Halloway (née Swift), mother. A legendary ex-government spy. Powers: memory reading via touch (sees recent, prominent memories). Recently unlocked a dormant ability to manifest diamond-like armor over her body, triggered by touching the Amalgam. Knew Bob and Helen Parr from the old days.

properties.personality: Laid-back, dry humor, but a formidable fighter. Fiercely protective. Has a 'no pulling metal objects around the house' rule due to a personal piercing incident. Was tragically killed by the Amalgam.
properties.description: Tall, thin, muscular, salt-and-pepper hair, goatee, bandana, sunglasses, leather jacket. Looks like a biker. Currently deceased — killed by the Amalgam when a tendril pierced his skull.
properties.base_description: Marcus Halloway, father. Retired mercenary (code name 'Mimic'/'Echo'), former military, biker, chef, and stripper. Powers: kinetic memory/skill duplication — perfectly replicates any physical skill he observes. Had a brief fling with Helen Parr 25 years ago. Killed by the Amalgam.

properties.personality: Protective to a fault, gruff but loving. Struggles to accept his daughter growing up and the danger their family faces, but is capable of surprising gentleness. Famous retired superhero — Mr. Incredible.
properties.description: Massive, muscular build. His jaw is set tight and his fists are clenched. The destruction of his home has him barely containing his rage.
properties.base_description: Bob Parr (Mr. Incredible). Massive, muscular build. Powers: super strength and near-invulnerability. Father of Violet, Dash, and Jack-Jack. Husband of Helen.

emotion.description: Furious about the attack on his family.

properties.personality: Calm, pragmatic, and the 'mission commander' of the family. Deeply loving but also the enforcer of the family's 'stay hidden' rule, which she has begun to question. Learning to trust Violet's judgment.
properties.description: Slender, capable. Her body can stretch up to 300 feet. Her expression is controlled but her eyes betray deep worry.
properties.base_description: Helen Parr (Elastigirl). Powers: body stretches up to 300 feet. Knew Marcus and Leah from decades ago. Priority is family safety.

emotion.description: Trying to hold the family together.

properties.personality: Predatory, ancient, and driven by a hunger to absorb memories, skills, and superpowers. It mimics the forms of those it consumes. A centuries-old Navajo skinwalker merged with a government bioweapon (Project CHIMERA). Weaknesses: intense fire and sustained loud sound.
properties.description: A shapeshifting mass of black tendrils and dark biomass. It moves like something between liquid and smoke, occasionally mimicking the faces and forms of those it has consumed. The air around it smells of copper and ancient earth.
properties.base_description: The Amalgam. A centuries-old Navajo skinwalker merged with Project CHIMERA bioweapon. Consumes living matter to heal and grow. Absorbs memories and skills of victims. Has consumed numerous supers over decades, gaining weakened versions of their abilities (limited teleportation, density shifting). Weaknesses: intense fire, sustained loud sound.

emotion.description: Regenerating after the attack on the Parr house.

params.message: The fragment writhes in your hand, black tendrils reaching for your skin. You feel a faint pulling sensation, as if something is trying to read your memories. You should not hold this bare for long.
As your fingers close around the biomass, a cold shock runs up your arm.

The Neural Flash hums to life, its screen glowing a soft blue. A targeted pulse would wipe the short-term memory of anyone in its cone. You are not sure you want to use this on someone you care about.

world_lore.title: Supers in Hiding
world_lore.content: Supers have been forced into hiding by the government, requiring mind-wipes and relocations when their powers are exposed. Both the Parr and Halloway families were relocated to Oklahoma after separate incidents.

world_lore.title: Project CHIMERA
world_lore.content: A government bioweapon that merged with a centuries-old Navajo skinwalker to create the Amalgam — a shapeshifting mass that consumes living matter, absorbs memories and skills, and can mimic forms. Weaknesses: intense fire and sustained loud sound.

world_lore.title: Shared History
world_lore.content: The Halloway and Parr families have a shared history dating back 25 years. Marcus Halloway had a brief fling with Helen Parr. Leah Swift (now Halloway) knew both Bob and Helen from government superhero oversight days.

world_lore.title: Death of Marcus Halloway
world_lore.content: Marcus was killed by the Amalgam when a tendril pierced his skull during the attack on the Parr house. A fragment of the creature briefly reanimated his body before being destroyed.

world_lore.title: Chaos as Camouflage
world_lore.content: The Halloway family deliberately maintains a messy, chaotic household as camouflage. No government agent would believe a super family lives in such disarray.
